remarks: One-of-a-kind/ Fully-renovated/ Move-in-ready 8th floor (unmatched views!) Bedford Towers home set in the heart of Downtown Stamford, offers an Open concept/ Meticulously updated, 2-Bedroom/1-Full Bathroom rear corner unit. New solid stranded bamboo flooring throughout, updated & bright Chef's kitchen w/ stainless steel appliances (gas stove), herring-bone, tiled backsplash, quartz counter tops, new custom cabinets make cooking & entertaining a pleasure. Bathroom has been totally redone featuring tiled floor & tub/shower surround. Entire home has been freshly painted while the primary bedroom w/ two large closets, has additional wall sound-proofing added. Large, bright Living Room includes Dining area overlooking private balcony (check out the sunsets!) plus the second bedroom which maybe used as an office/den. Large entry foyer & plenty of large closets throughout compliment the home. The building features a spacious lobby, main level laundry facilities, private storage locker, on-site superintendent, private party room and Deeded/ reserved parking space #63 is located on left side of building directly below the unit. Affordable HOA fee covers heat, hot water, gas, water & sewer plus year-round building maintenance. Walk to restaurants, shopping, train, library, parks, mall, houses of worship, bus & more! Available immediately, nothing to do but move in!
